precepts.text: Keep not thou silence, O God; thine enemies make a tumult and they that hate thee have lifted up the head. They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones, saying come, let us cut them off from being a nation, that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance. AIPAC counsel, The Israel Project counsel, ADL counsel, Canary Mission counsel, secret meetings to cut us off from the Most High and morph us into the image of dysfunction. Add this to your prayers. They are not doing it to those over there; they do it to us because we are the Israelites.
precepts.point: The nations are terrified we are learning and teaching this Bible. World committees, AIPAC, the ADL, and the Israeli official in Atlanta said the black man leading was the number one threat, not Hamas or Hezbollah, because they read the prophecy.

note.label: The Image of Dysfunction or the Image of God Which One Are You?

precepts.why:
Achior runs Israel's whole history down to Holofernes, and in it is part of the key to getting out of this mess: “whilst they sinned not before their God, they prospered, because the God that hateth iniquity was with them.” So the objective of our enemies is to keep us from obeying God, to keep us in dysfunction so they can dominate us. They love that we're brilliant; they want the body and the mind, but they don't want us using that mind for ourselves. And the counsel he gives: “if there be any error against this people, and they sin against their God, let us consider that this shall be their ruin, and let us go up, and we shall overcome them.” That is exactly what is happening to us now. “But if there be no iniquity in their nation, let my lord now pass by, lest their Lord defend them.” That's where our power is: checking each other so there is no sin in the nation.

Add this to your prayers: “Keep not thou silence, O God: hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God. For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult: and they that hate thee have lifted up the head.” They are God's enemies, lifting up their heads against everything that is about the Most High.

“They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones.” AIPAC counsel, The Israel Project counsel, ADL counsel, Canary Mission counsel: consultation, secret meetings against us. The nations are terrified that we are learning and teaching this Bible. An Israeli official came down to Atlanta, and in a meeting with AIPAC and the ADL they said the black man leading was the number one threat. Not Hamas, not Hezbollah: the blacks in this country, because they read the prophecy.

“They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.” In their meetings, the discussion is to cut us off from the Most High, from who we truly are, from the image of God, and morph us into the image of dysfunction. They did it through a slave system designed to destroy the manhood of the black male, and they do it in the schools, killing the confidence of our sons by the fourth grade. They didn't bring dummies here: we were warriors and family heads, kings, princes, judges, architects, engineers, doctors, mathematicians, an industrious and skillful people. So no, we're not niggas; that lie garbage was given to us to make us think we are a different image than what God made us. They are not doing it to those over there. They do it to us because we are the Israelites.

They shoot in secret at the perfect, encourage themselves in an evil matter, commune of laying snares privily, and accomplish a diligent search; the inward thought and heart is deep. They think deep on how to trap us into perpetuating our own destruction, making us image ourselves as nothing so they no longer have to enforce it: parading a simple brother in a dress, stripping our women, keeping us clowns on the court and the stage who know nothing of their ancestors. If we as men do not do this work, no other species will.

precepts.why:
“Hear my voice, O God, in my prayer: preserve my life from fear of the enemy. Hide me from the secret counsel of the wicked; from the insurrection of the workers of iniquity.” It is the same secret counsel of Psalms 83, taken against the people who, as Achior told Holofernes, can only be overcome when they sin against their God.

“Who whet their tongue like a sword, and bend their bows to shoot their arrows, even bitter words.” Their bitter words: calling us anti-Semitic, when we are the Semites, from Shem, and their fathers came from Esau.

“That they may shoot in secret at the perfect: suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not. They encourage themselves in an evil matter: they commune of laying snares privily; they say, Who shall see them? They search out iniquities; they accomplish a diligent search: both the inward thought of every one of them, and the heart, is deep.” They think deep on how to trap us into perpetuating our own destruction: making us image ourselves as nothing, so they no longer have to enforce it. Parading a simple brother in a dress, stripping our women, keeping us clowns on the court and on the stage who know nothing of their ancestors.

That is the image of dysfunction they laid as a snare, so that there would be error in this people and it would be their ruin. The answer is to get back into the commandments so there is no iniquity in the nation, and the Lord defends us. If we as men do not do this work, no other species will.

That's why our music in particular is so degraded: every video oversexualized, everything aimed at destroying the young people's minds. They said, if we can't get them in religion, we'll get them in the workforce; if not the workforce, gangs; if not gangs, porn; we'll turn them into criminals. Young ones, sit and watch porn all day and it will fry your brain, and then you act it out, and that's how predators are made.

note.label: Pay The Price: Pleasure Now Regret Later

precepts.why:
The psalm says of the nations, “They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones.” Who are God's people? We are God's people. And Judith shows one of their crafty counsels from the beginning: “Therefore the king of Egypt rose up against them, and dealt subtilly with them, and brought them low with labouring in brick, and made them slaves.”

That is one of their crafty counsels: we are going to work them to death. Today many of our people are working two big jobs, living paycheck to paycheck, too poor to stop working. It is happening even more with Trump in office. There is no middle class; that thing is gone. You can't work for a living wage and survive out here.

There was a time, and some of you older people understand, when you could have a job delivering milk or eggs, or work in a post office, and buy a home on one salary. Not no more. People with full-time jobs making $50,000 a year in LA are homeless, living in storage units.

They said, we have to find ways to keep the children of Israel under our foot. If we can't get them in religion, we will get them in the workforce. If not the workforce, gangs; if not gangs, porn; we will turn them into criminals. That is the crafty counsel of the nations, confederate with one consent, to cut Israel off from being a nation. In this world, all we have got is us.

note.label: Psalm 44: We Got Not the Land by Our Own Sword

precepts.why:
“For the voice of him that reproacheth and blasphemeth; by reason of the enemy and avenger.” The enemy was told exactly how it works with Israel: “whilst they sinned not before their God, they prospered, because the God that hateth iniquity was with them. But when they departed from the way which he appointed them, they were destroyed in many battles very sore, and were led captives into a land that was not their’s, and the temple of their God was cast to the ground, and their cities were taken by the enemies.” And the enemy's plan: “if there be any error against this people, and they sin against their God, let us consider that this shall be their ruin, and let us go up, and we shall overcome them.”

That is the enemy's play to this day. They will call us any name we want except Esau, as long as we keep celebrating Christmas, Thanksgiving, New Year's, the 4th of July, and birthdays. If they keep us in sin, the Most High will not fight our battles, and they know it: as long as Israel sinned not, they prospered, but when they departed from his way they were spoiled and led captive.

precepts.text: Holofernes asked the princes of Moab and captains of Ammon who these people were, their cities, army, power and king.
precepts.point: The kings assembled, saw Zion, marveled, were troubled and hasted away; fear and pain took hold of them as of a woman in travail.

note.label: Psalm 48: Zion the Joy of the Whole Earth

precepts.why:
“For, lo, the kings were assembled, they passed by together. They saw it, and so they marvelled; they were troubled, and hasted away.” Judith shows that fear in the enemy. When Holofernes, the chief captain of the army of Assur, heard that the children of Israel “had prepared for war, and had shut up the passages of the hill country”, he “called all the princes of Moab, and the captains of Ammon, and all the governors of the sea coast” and asked, “Tell me now, ye sons of Chanaan, who this people is, that dwelleth in the hill country, and what are the cities that they inhabit, and what is the multitude of their army, and wherein is their power and strength, and what king is set over them, or captain of their army”.

The enemy did not know who this people was, what their power and strength were, or what king was set over them. When Israel was in rulership the nations fled and were afraid; they understood they could not come against Israel when the Most High was among them.

precepts.point: The kings assembled, saw Zion, marveled, were troubled and hasted away; fear and pain took hold of them as of a woman in travail.

note.label: Psalm 48: Zion the Joy of the Whole Earth

precepts.why:
The answer Holofernes got explains why the kings “were troubled, and hasted away”: “whilst they sinned not before their God, they prospered, because the God that hateth iniquity was with them. But when they departed from the way which he appointed them, they were destroyed in many battles very sore, and were led captives into a land that was not their’s”. So the counsel was, “if there be any error against this people, and they sin against their God, let us consider that this shall be their ruin, and let us go up, and we shall overcome them. But if there be no iniquity in their nation, let my lord now pass by, lest their Lord defend them, and their God be for them, and we become a reproach before all the world.”

When Israel kept the commandments the nations could not overcome them, lest they become a reproach before all the world. That is the fear and pain “as of a woman in travail” that took hold of the kings. Israel's savour is the commandments; with them, the Most High is among us and the nations flee. Without them, Israel is good for nothing but to be trodden under foot.

precepts.text: Even the heathen knew Israel prospered while keeping the law and was led captive once they departed from it.
precepts.point: The nations always knew why we went into captivity; it is sin, the breaking of the Most High's laws, that becomes our weakness and how we are overcome.

note.label: Jeremiah 40: Jeremiah Set Free and Gedaliah Made Governor

precepts.why:
Nebuzaradan, the captain of the guard, a heathen, told Jeremiah that the Lord had pronounced this evil because “ye have sinned against the Lord, and have not obeyed his voice, therefore this thing is come upon you.” The nations always knew why we went into captivity. Judith records the heathen saying the same: “And whilst they sinned not before their God, they prospered, because the God that hateth iniquity was with them.”

“But when they departed from the way which he appointed them, they were destroyed in many battles very sore, and were led captives into a land that was not their’s, and the temple of their God was cast to the ground, and their cities were taken by the enemies.” Even the heathen knew Israel prospered while keeping the law and was led captive once they departed from it. It is sin, the breaking of the Most High's laws, that becomes our weakness and how we are overcome.

The nations know that our Bible is what is happening. It is not just a book; it is a weapon. You are the children of that book, but you are not made to understand that, on purpose.

The Romans came from the Greeks, Spain from the Romans, so that knowledge went all the way down to Columbus. They need to know what held you together as a nation, what your strong man at the door is. The strong man in our case is the Bible and our adherence to the Bible. When we stop adhering to the Bible, the strong man is gone and our goods can be spoiled.

And whilst they sinned not before their God, they prospered, because the God that hateth iniquity was with them. He is warning the captain of the army: if they are not sinning, you cannot take them. Their objective, then and now, is to make sure we do not keep God's commandments.

But when they departed from the way which he appointed them, they were destroyed in many battles very sore, and were led captives into a land that was not theirs. When we departed from God's commandments, it was easy to destroy us. So they must keep us in sin. Think about that.

Now therefore, my lord and governor, if there be any error in this people, and they sin against their God, let us consider that this shall be their ruin, and let us go up, and we shall overcome them: that is what is happening today. As long as they can keep us in sin, they can exploit, dominate, rob, and pillage, and leave us in a wilderness of foolishness.

But if there be no iniquity in their nation, let my lord now pass by, lest their Lord defend them, and their God be for them, and we become a reproach before all the world. They do not want that to happen; that same knowledge persists even today. That is why they accuse us to the Father day and night, and why they operate the conditioning: they throw the rock and hide their hand, giving us the opportunity and the influence toward every evil, then standing back as though they had nothing to do with it. The Most High is going to deal with them for that; we have to get our minds right and repent.
